title: Georgian short-term residence permit for owners of real estate worth more than USD 150,000, with their spouse and children

sources.title: Law on the Legal Status of Aliens and Stateless Persons, Article 15 – Types of residence permits, (j): a short-term permit for an owner of real estate worth over USD 150 000, spouse and child/children
Law on the Legal Status of Aliens and Stateless Persons, Article 16 – The validity period of a residence permit, 1(f) and 3: extended one year at a time, up to 12 years; ends if the ownership ends
Law on the Legal Status of Aliens and Stateless Persons, Article 2 – Definition of terms, (a): alien – a person who is not a citizen of Georgia
Law on the Legal Status of Aliens and Stateless Persons, Article 14 – Body issuing Georgian residence permits and general conditions for issuing a residence permit, 1 to 1^4
Law on the Legal Status of Aliens and Stateless Persons, Article 18 – Grounds for denying the issuance of Georgian residence permits, 1 and 4, as amended by Law No 1803 of 25 June 2026
Law on the Legal Status of Aliens and Stateless Persons, Article 17 – Considering and making a decision on the matter of granting a Georgian residence permit, 6: documents in Georgian
Law on the Legal Status of Aliens and Stateless Persons, Article 70 – Georgian Visa and Georgian residence permit fees and charges, 2(b): a service fee set by a Government ordinance
Public Service Development Agency, residence permits: short-term permit decided on the 30th, 20th or 10th day for GEL 300, 450 or 600; spouse and children apply with a copy of the holder's permit
Government Ordinance No 389 of 27 August 2025, amending art. 3(4) of the Rules approved by Ordinance No 520 of 2014: for a short-term permit, the holder's permit must have more than 6 months left

requirements.title: Funds for a Georgian property, not agricultural land, whose market value exceeds the equivalent in GEL of USD 150,000
Not a citizen of Georgia: residence permits are issued to aliens, and an alien is a person who is not a citizen of Georgia

assessments.title: Ownership of the property registered under Georgian law, its market value set by a certified assessor of an accredited body; the permit ends if the ownership ends
The owner, and each family member applying, in Georgia on a lawful ground: not as an asylum seeker, on a deferred obligation to leave, on an ordinary C visa or under Article 10(3^1)
May be refused: the grounds on which the alien obtained the right to stay in Georgia no longer exist
May be refused: sufficient grounds to assume the residence is inadvisable for state security or public safety, or an activity that threatens them
May be refused: crime against peace and humanity; wanted for a crime; final conviction in Georgia, less serious unless expunged, serious or exceptionally serious even if expunged; pending prosecution
May be refused: an infectious or other disease on the Health Ministry's list whose nature, severity or duration may threaten the population of Georgia
May be refused: forged or invalid documents submitted, incorrect data in the application or significant information concealed
No permit for an alien whose expulsion from Georgia is under review or has been decided, even while the decision is under appeal
Application and documents in Georgian, unless the law lets the Agency accept another language, so marriage and birth certificates need a translation; a passport with Latin data needs none
The spouse and children apply for the same permit once the owner holds it, with a copy of it and proof of the relationship; the owner's permit must have more than 6 months left

dependents.title: Children, of any age: Article 15(j) and the Agency name the owner's child or children with no age limit, where Article 15(h) and (k) limit theirs to a minor child

costs.title: Real estate in Georgia, not agricultural land, worth more than USD 150,000
Service fee for deciding the principal's permit application on the 30th calendar day: GEL 300 (GEL 450 on the 20th day, GEL 600 on the 10th)
Each family member applies for the same short-term permit, with the same service fee: GEL 300 for a decision on the 30th calendar day (GEL 450 on the 20th, GEL 600 on the 10th)

durations.title: Decision on the application on the 10th, 20th or 30th calendar day, by the service fee paid
The permit's validity is extended one year at a time while the alien owns the property, up to 12 years in all
